note: [L] carries the plan through the abstract `Eligible`/`Agrees`/`Comparable` relations: an equal-height child reuses its own menu (the flattening) and a strictly higher child is replaced by `high` with a horizon chosen by `exists_nat_gt`, the improvement (H+1)(a_u-a_v) appearing as the inequality on `N`.

have hPick(j:Fin n)(W' γ':ℝ):∃ q,good j q ∧ Eligible l T (down j z) b_b q ∧ Agrees U l T (down j z) (Tree.topAge (fork n f) κ a) b_b W' γ' (p j) q := by
      let e:=childAge j a
      rcases (h.inside j).ageLower.eq_or_lt with he|he
      · change (Tree.topAge (fork n f) κ a)=(f j).topAge ((fork n f).topAge κ a) (childAge j a) at he
        obtain ⟨q,hq,he'⟩:= (rec j b_b (hB j)).2 W' γ'
        exact ⟨q,by unfold good; rw [← he] at hq; exact hq, hq.earns ((h_b j).trans (hB j)),by intro J _ w y s hw hv; rw [he] at hv; exact he' w y s hw hv⟩
      let hv:=ready j
      change Meets U R l T (down j z) _ ((f j).topAge (Tree.topAge (fork n f) κ a) e) _ _ at hv; obtain ⟨H,h',hg,hG⟩:=high U R (childWages j v) hv (h.inside j) rfl he ((le_max_right ..).trans h_b') W' γ' 0
      exact ⟨_,hg,hg.earns ((le_max_right ..).trans h_b'), hG⟩
    obtain ⟨B,h₁,h₂⟩:= sequential U (W:=W) (r:=γ) p good h ((le_max_right ..).trans h_b') hT hp hPick
    exact ⟨fuse B, comparable_bundle hT v h B h₁,Agrees.then U hT (@he') h₂⟩

proof_context.conclusion: For each child, equal heights reuse the child's own menu (flattening) and strictly higher children are replaced via `high`; the replaced menus are combined by `sequential`.

lemma high (hk:t.topAge κ a=k)(hg:κ<k)(b₀:κ≤ b) (W r:ℝ)(D:ℕ) : ∃ H:ℕ, D ≤ H ∧ let P:=loadedRaw U R z v (Tree.center z) H; Comparable l T z κ Ω P ∧ Agrees U l T z κ b W r (Menu.raw z v) P :=by
     subst k; obtain ⟨N,hN⟩:=exists_nat_gt ((Ω+W*b-r)/(t.topAge κ a-κ)); let q:=max N D
     refine ⟨q,(le_max_right ..),cost_loaded U R v hd hg.le q, fun w y s he hu hb=> ?_⟩
     have hc:=h.zeroBorder
     apply (hd.tested w y q s b κ hb (interval_comp hu (fun _:Unit=>_) id) hu hc b₀ hg.le).mono ?_ |>.congr (Eventually.of_forall fun i=> loaded_test U R ..)
     rw [div_lt_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hg)] at hN; have hf₀:= mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (show (N:ℝ) ≤ ↑q + 1 from by exact_mod_cast le_max_left N D |>.trans q.le_succ) (sub_nonneg.mpr hg.le)
     linarith only [hf₀,hN,mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he (hc.trans b₀)]

proof_context.conclusion: A child with strictly larger age can be replaced by the loaded expansion to a horizon `H >= D`, with `H` chosen by `exists_nat_gt` so that the remainder rate is below any prescribed value.

lemma sequential (P:Fin n→Menu S L)(good:(i:Fin n)→Menu S L→Prop)
       (hg:Regular l T (fork n f) a ν z)(hb:((fork n f).topAge a ν) ≤ b)(hT:Tendsto T l atTop)(h:∀ j,Eligible l T (down j z) b (P j))
       (h_pick : ∀ j W' r', ∃ B:Menu S L,good j B ∧ Eligible l T (down j z) b B ∧ Agrees U l T (down j z) ((fork n f).topAge a ν) b W' r' (P j) B) :
       ∃ P':Fin n→Menu S L, (∀ j,good j (P' j)) ∧ Agrees U l T z ((fork n f).topAge a ν) b W r (fuse P) (fuse P') :=by

proof_context.conclusion: The replacements are made one child at a time, each chosen after the earlier ones are fixed, with accuracy `r` for the whole fuse.
